description: This file contains a fake implementation of a custom metrics client for testing purposes within the Kubernetes metrics package, including mock actions and methods for retrieving metrics.

classes.name: GetForActionImpl
classes.description: Implementation of the GetForAction interface, representing a fake get action with metric name and label selector.

classes.name: FakeCustomMetricsClient
classes.description: Fake client for custom metrics, providing methods for root-scoped and namespace-scoped metrics.

classes.name: fakeNamespacedMetrics
classes.description: Mock implementation of namespace-scoped metrics interface.

classes.name: fakeRootScopedMetrics
classes.description: Mock implementation of root-scoped metrics interface.

methods.name: GetMetricName
methods.description: Returns the metric name associated with the get action.

methods.name: GetLabelSelector
methods.description: Returns the label selector associated with the get action.

methods.name: GetSubresource
methods.description: Returns the subresource, which is the metric name.

methods.name: DeepCopy
methods.description: Creates a deep copy of the get action.

methods.name: NewGetForAction
methods.description: Constructs a new get action for a specific group kind, namespace, and resource.

methods.name: NewRootGetForAction
methods.description: Constructs a new root get action for a specific group kind and resource.

methods.name: RootScopedMetrics
methods.description: Returns the metrics interface for root-scoped metrics.

methods.name: NamespacedMetrics
methods.description: Returns the metrics interface for namespace-scoped metrics.

methods.name: GetForObject
methods.description: Retrieves a specific metric value for an object, simulating a fake API call.

methods.name: GetForObjects
methods.description: Retrieves multiple metric values for objects based on a selector.
